Triage: lands in area:cloud · domain:server · Bug · p2 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: on a cloud-managed runtime, a stored `auth.email_password_enabled` re-advertises password sign-in, so the login page draws a form whose every submit fails with 409. End users see a sign-in path that cannot work. That is a user-facing defect, raised p3 → p2 to match its sibling #34171 (same login surface, p2). Audit restatement, tier 3. Recorded 2026-11-27T06:29Z.
